# DXF fixture provenance

These seven files are exact Git-tracked blobs from the pinned LibreCAD target
repository at commit `3c7785ebbcbfc8f3c8f79dbba093aff09cdec753` under
`librecad/src/lib/filters/tests/testdata/dxf/`.  LibreCAD's accompanying
`PROVENANCE.md` identifies them as GPL-2.0-or-later, project-authored test
inputs.  Their source blob IDs, hashes, sizes, versions, and feature scope
are recorded in `metadata/fixture-registry.json`.

No downloaded, customer-provided, converted, mutated, minimized, or generated
drawing bytes are included here.
